title: 第17章 这事很大第18章 夜探将军府
content_zh:
四人骑上快马，往府衙方向疾速赶路。
路上，姜峰三人也从宋明远口中得知了消息。
就在半个时辰之前，不良人府衙遭受贼人入侵。
有数名黑衣人暗中潜入府衙，被守夜的同僚发现，恰好今夜统领大人不在，府衙只有一位副统领当值。
“咱们府衙有五位副统领，都是步入五境的武夫。
除了萧大人以外，还有副统领郭飞，周奎，司徒映，温韬。”
“今夜负责值守衙门的是副统领郭飞，敌人闯入以后，郭副统领不敌。”
“看守地牢的衙役死了九个，值夜的同僚两死七伤，还有，昨夜我们抓回来的那个人被救走了。”
宋明远沉声说道。
姜峰也明白事情的严重性。
不良人府衙被贼人闯进来，同僚被杀，人犯被劫……这事很大！
等他们四人回到府衙时，整个衙门已经戒严。
负责值夜的副统领郭飞此刻正跪在大堂，他的右臂无力的耷拉下来，腹部有一处刀伤，鲜血淋漓，显然是被劫狱的贼人所伤。
统领苏烈站在他面前，面无表情的看着他：“我让你看着府衙，你就是这么看的？让贼人肆无忌惮的冲进来把人劫走，死的活的，你愣是一个都没拦住？这话你拿来应付我可以，可你觉得大帅知道了，陛下知道了，会怎么处置你？”
“卑职知罪！
请统领大人责罚！”
郭飞额头冒出冷汗，一半的痛的，一半却是惊的。
今夜闯进来的贼人实力强大不假，可事发之时，他没有及时发出信号，以至于让贼人顺利逃脱，也是事实。
他太自信了，以为凭自己的实力，可以将来人一网打尽，却不料此举正中贼人下怀。
苏烈目光冷肃的盯着郭飞：“我给你一天时间，把人抓回来，抓不回来，你就不用再回来了。”

郭飞咬紧牙关，道：“喏。”
他转身离开大堂，开始召集府衙内所有人手。
姜峰换完不良人的制服，跟在宋明远的身后，来到府衙前院，此时这里已经聚集了数十个手持火把的不良人。
今夜，无论是归属于哪个队伍的不良人，都暂时归于郭飞统辖。
咔嚓。
郭飞用力将脱臼的右臂掰直，随后甩了甩发麻的手臂，从旁边的衙役身上撕下一根布条，紧紧缠住腹部的伤口。
整个过程，他没有发出一声痛呼，眼神反而闪烁着择人而噬的凶光。
他目光扫视着前院的不良人，单手按住腰间的佩刀，沉声道：“今夜，哪怕把整个江州城给我翻过来，也要找到那伙贼人。
搜寻不力者，斩！
阳奉阴违者，斩！
放跑贼人者，斩！
现在，出发！”
“喏！”
数十个不良人从府衙大门内鱼贯而出。
这时，宋明远壮着胆子来到郭飞面前，行了个叉手礼：“郭大人，卑职有事禀报，事关贼人。”
郭飞端坐在马背上，低头俯瞰着他，冷冷道：“说。”
宋明远咬了咬牙，最后还是选择相信姜峰，道：“卑职想去大牢查看一番，或许能够从一些蛛丝马迹中找到对方隐藏的地方。”
郭飞直接抽出腰间的景刀，刀未出鞘，朝着宋明远的肩膀重重砸了下去：“你们真当本统领刚刚说的是玩笑话吗？”
打人的时候，郭飞还动用的气机，造成的伤势不重，却能让人极度疼痛。
宋明远肩膀瞬间红肿，痛得额头直冒冷汗，可整个过程他却是不敢吭声。
content_en:
The four of them mounted their fast horses and hurried towards the government office.
On the way, Jiang Feng and the others also learned the news from Song Mingyuan.
Just half an hour ago, the bad man's office was invaded by thieves.
Several men in black sneaked into the government office secretly and were discovered by colleagues who were keeping watch. The commander-in-chief happened to be away tonight, and there was only one deputy commander on duty in the government office.
"Our government office has five deputy commanders, all of whom are martial artists who have entered the fifth realm.
In addition to Mr. Xiao, there are also deputy commanders Guo Fei, Zhou Kui, Situ Ying and Wen Tao. "
"The person in charge of guarding the Yamen tonight is Deputy Commander Guo Fei. After the enemy broke in, Deputy Commander Guo was defeated."
"Nine of the government officials guarding the dungeon died, and two of the colleagues on night duty died and seven were injured. Also, the man we captured last night was rescued."
Song Mingyuan said in a deep voice.
Jiang Feng also understood the seriousness of the matter.
A bad person's government office was broken into by thieves, colleagues were killed, and criminals were robbed... This is a big deal!
When the four of them returned to the government office, the entire government office was under martial law.
Guo Fei, the deputy commander in charge of the night watch, was kneeling in the lobby at the moment. His right arm was hanging down weakly. There was a knife wound on his abdomen, which was dripping with blood. It was obviously injured by the robbers who robbed the prison.
Commander Su Lie stood in front of him and looked at him expressionlessly: "I asked you to look at the government office. Is this how you look at it? Let the thieves rush in unscrupulously and kidnap people, dead or alive, and you didn't stop any of them? You can use this to deal with me, but do you think the commander-in-chief knows and His Majesty knows, what will he do to you?"
"I know my crime due to my humble position!
Please punish me, my lord! "
Cold sweat broke out on Guo Fei's forehead, half in pain and half in shock.
It is true that the thief who broke in tonight was powerful, but it is also true that he did not send a signal in time when the incident occurred, allowing the thief to escape smoothly.
He was too confident, thinking that with his own strength, he could catch all the people in the future, but he didn't expect that this would play into the thieves' ambitions.
Su Lie stared at Guo Fei with cold eyes: "I'll give you one day to catch him. If you can't catch him, you don't have to come back."
Guo Fei gritted his teeth and said, "Here."
He turned and left the lobby and began to summon all the people in the government office.
After Jiang Feng changed into the uniform of a delinquent, he followed Song Mingyuan to the front yard of the government office, where dozens of delinquents holding torches had gathered.
Tonight, no matter which team they belong to, the bad guys are temporarily under Guo Fei's control.
Click.
Guo Fei straightened his dislocated right arm with force, then shook his numb arm, tore off a strip of cloth from the government servant next to him, and wrapped it tightly around the wound on his abdomen.
During the whole process, he did not let out a cry of pain, but his eyes flashed with a fierce light that chose others to devour.
He glanced at the bad guys in the front yard, held the saber at his waist with one hand, and said solemnly: "Tonight, even if I turn over the entire Jiangzhou City, I still have to find that group of thieves.
Those who fail to search will be killed!
Anyone who violates Yang Feng Yin will be beheaded!
Those who let the thieves escape will be killed!
Now, let’s go! "
"Here!"
Dozens of bad people filed out of the government office gate.
At this time, Song Mingyuan bravely came to Guo Fei and made a cross-hand salute: "Master Guo, I have something to report for my humble position, and it concerns a thief."
Guo Fei sat on the horse, lowered his head and looked down at him, and said coldly: "Say."
Song Mingyuan gritted his teeth, and finally chose to believe Jiang Feng, saying: "I want to check in the prison. Maybe I can find out where the other party is hiding from some clues."
Guo Fei directly pulled out the Jing Dao from his waist. Without the knife out of its sheath, he hit Song Mingyuan hard on the shoulder: "Do you really think what I just said was a joke?"
When beating people, Guo Fei also used Qi, which caused minor injuries but caused extreme pain.
Song Mingyuan's shoulder instantly became red and swollen, and the pain caused cold sweat to break out on his forehead, but he did not dare to say a word during the whole process.
